## Curvas y espectros de amenaza {#sec-hazard_results}

{{< include /_chapters/psha.aep.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/AEP.ES.qmd",
    stem = "hazard-aep",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = if (knitr::is_html_output()) SiteTable$label[[i]] else NULL,
    level = 4L,
    anchor = "sec-hazard-aep-site",
    context = "peligro AEP"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
